description: Use when you need a crypto token price or market data for a Base token, quoted from on-chain liquidity. Do not use for tokens that only trade off Base or on other DEXs (Aerodrome is not read), price history or OHLC. Returns JSON with the USD price of a token on Base computed on-chain from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, with pool, fee tier and depth for 0.002 USDC per call. Typical response time 1200 ms (p95). Category: Trading.

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON
